fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) is scheduled to report Q3 results on November 24, with revenue guidance of $49 billion (±$500 million) and non-GAAP EPS of $6.50 (±10 cents).
fields.summary_ko.1: With Q2 AI server orders of $60.9 billion and $95 billion backlog, Q3 revenue is estimated to grow over $5 billion, with consensus of $50.87 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: AI server revenue is expected to increase from $16.4 billion in Q2 to $19 billion in Q3, with ISG segment annual revenue growth rate surging to 122%.
